name: Health, Behavior, and Society
notes: Twelve required courses plus one prerequisite. The major satisfies the social sciences requirement of the Rochester Curriculum.
The requirement-directory spreadsheet lists this major under a Gender-and-Women's-Studies URL, which is a data-entry slip; the requirements here come from the Public Health department page.
PHLT 102 'Introduction to Public Health II' is no longer required and is no longer offered. Students already declared before that change follow their original program.
STAT 212 was valid until spring 2024; STAT 180 is the current course.
Prerequisites of individual courses are not counted toward the major.
Overlap: no more than two courses may overlap between a public health major and another major - PSYC 101 and the introductory statistics course are excluded from that count.
Up to two transfer courses may be used with faculty advisor approval, and up to two PHLT internship courses may count toward the major.
Students may major, minor, OR complete a cluster within the public health-related programs, but not more than one of these.

requirementGroups.label: Prerequisite: Introduction to Psychology
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Pre-Requisite Course (One Course): PSYC 101: Introduction to Psychology

requirementGroups.label: Public health general core
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Public Health General Core (Four Courses): PHLT 101: Introduction to Public Health I; PHLT 103: Concepts of Epidemiology

requirementGroups.label: Introductory statistics
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: STAT 212: Appl. Stat. I (valid until spring 2024) or STAT 180 'Introduction to Applied Statistical Methodology' (valid beginning fall 2024)

requirementGroups.label: Public health or medical ethics
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: PHIL 228 (PHIL 228W): Public Health Ethics or PHIL 225: Ethical Decisions in Medicine

requirementGroups.label: Medical or public health anthropology
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: ANTH 216: Medical Anthropology or PHLT 215W (H): Public Health Anthropology

requirementGroups.label: Introduction to the U.S. Health System
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: PHLT 116: Introduction to the U.S. Health System

requirementGroups.label: Behavioral or health psychology
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: PSYC 283: Behavioral Medicine or PSYC 230: Psychology of Well-Being or PSYC 262: Human Motivation

requirementGroups.label: Electives (5)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Electives (Five Courses). Choose five of the following: BCSC/PSYC 246; CLST 208; GSWS 206/PHLT 206; GSWS 213; GSWS 232; HIST 203/203W; HIST 242/242W; HIST 303W; HIST 359W; HIST 373W; HIST 383W; INTR 205; INTR 237; MHB 220; MHB 420U; MHB 473U; MHB 480U; MUR 236/PHLT 227; PHLT 216; PHLT 234W; PHLT 236 or PHLT 230; PHLT 265W; PHLT 394A; PHLT 394C; PHLT 397W; PSCI 255; PSYC 209; RELC 183; WRTG 266
requirementGroups.note: Several options carry validity windows or permission requirements noted on the page.
